# scripts/PlayerUtils/VerletRope.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/PlayerUtils/VerletRope.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

ClimbVolume with a simulated rope or chain anchored at the node origin.
World-space points obey distance constraints; the overlap box follows them.
Grip parameters measure metres from the top; MultiMesh renders the links.

Base: `not declared`. Registered class: `none`.
